title: Different responses of heterogeneous graft presentations in bone reconstructions during sinus lift elevation surgery: an immunolabeling and histomorphometric study performed in rabbits. de
authors: Siqueira NB, Silva ACED, Pereira RDS, Hochuli -Vieira E, Lisboa-Filho PN, de Deus CBD, Okamoto R. Front Oral Maxillofac Med 2022;4:1. doi: 10.21037/fomm-21-45
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Better performance was observed in the group in w hich Cerabone was used in association with raloxifene (G4), with better bone formation responses compared to the experimental groups” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
